Engineering Review; Doc Gen / Docs manager draft docs. The flow: idea -> product spec (Confluence) -> Jira tickets (docs/PRODUCT_FLOW.md)

LibreChat toolApproval `ask` list pauses on matching <toolset>_<action>_mcp_<server> calls
